Class SomeStacksServer

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.SomeStacksServer
public final class SomeStacksServer extends Object
Loader-neutral server lifecycle operations called by each loader's native event adapters.

  • Method Details

    • onServerStarting

      public static void onServerStarting(net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer server)
      Starts session accounting, loads world policy, then builds the login snapshot. Loader backends and networking must be installed before this server-thread callback, which runs before world loading and player joins.

    • onServerStopped

      public static void onServerStopped()
      Releases the stopped server and clears session diagnostics after world activity ends.

    • onPolicyReloaded

      public static void onPolicyReloaded()
      Queues a native policy reload on the running server thread; inactive sessions are ignored. Changed policy rebuilds the cached snapshot before synchronizing connected players.

    • reloadPolicy

      public static int reloadPolicy(net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer server)
      Refreshes policy on the server thread and synchronizes only changed policy.

    • publishPolicy

      public static int publishPolicy(net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer server)
      Publishes policy changes from file reloads and persisted command edits exactly once.

    • onPlayerJoined

      public static void onPlayerJoined(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player)
      Sends the startup/reload snapshot on the server thread after play networking is ready.

    • onPlayerLeft

      public static void onPlayerLeft(UUID playerId)
      Clears gesture and sound state when this player disconnects, before a later reconnect.

    • onServerTickEnd

      public static void onServerTickEnd()
      Advances queued gallery work once at the end of each server tick.

    • registerCommands
